name: PolyBench
description: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) are increasingly capable of reasoning over audio. However, existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of reasoning in polyphonic audio, where multiple sound events co-occur and induce compositional structure. In this work, we introduce PolyBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate compositional reasoning in polyphonic audio. PolyBench comprises five evaluation subsets covering counting, classification, detection, concurrency, and duration estimation, requiring reasoning over multiple concurrent events and their relations.
